latest_release.name: v2.15.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

* fix: replace embedded CA trust store after eMudhra compromise by @skot in https://github.com/bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner/pull/2040

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bitaxeorg/ESP-Miner/compare/v2.15.3...v2.15.4
